description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Serah)] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Serah)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Water abilities, causes [Imperil Water 10% (15s)] after using three equipped Water abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Serah)], removes [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Serah)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Serah)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, causes [Imperil Water 20% (5s)] to the lowest HP% enemy when removed, grants [Water +50% Boost 1] and [Instant Cast 1] to the user when removed

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3
